criteria.criterion: A test puts different records in the worktree and in the in-tree records/ and checks that each moved reader returns the worktree's records: Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records, the xtask walltime reader, introspect walks, status, forecasting, scoring, retry carry, auditor, audit, and the other moved readers in the inventory. Run cargo test --locked.
criteria.evidence: Ran these. The worktree-versus-in-tree tests cover Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records (through records_root), status, trace, mistakes, land_pr and the walltime read_jobs. No test runs forecasting, scoring (manage.rs:194, run.rs:2392), retry carry (reading.rs retry), the auditor (auditor.rs:300), introspect's event_of_job and introspect, proposals, backtest, hestia, review, watcher or drain against a worktree that differs from records/. Those were one-line swaps to load_current or records_root, and the scan blocks a bypass. Still, the criterion names these readers and asks for a test of each, so it is not shown.

criteria.criterion: A real-git fixture whose HEAD has no records/ loads records through the worktree. A negative control shows the same assertion fails with the old HEAD-based load. Run cargo test --locked.
criteria.evidence: load_current_reads_the_worktree_where_head_has_no_records passes. It builds a real git repository whose HEAD has no records/. Records::load_current returns JOB_B from the worktree, while Records::load and RecordSet::load at HEAD return nothing (the negative control).

criteria.criterion: A test calls land_pr on a checkout whose HEAD has no records/ and shows it resolves the job's verification and candidate from the worktree. Run cargo test --locked.
criteria.evidence: land_pr_resolves_the_job_from_the_worktree passes. With no worktree, land_pr fails before the remote step. With the job, a Pass verification and the candidate placed only in the worktree, it passes the no-verification and no-candidate checks and stops at the missing `origin` remote. gh.rs:2513 now calls crate::store::Records::load_current.

criteria.criterion: With no worktree present, each moved reader falls back to records/ and returns the same result as before. athena status and a forecast succeed on a scratch checkout whose working tree has no records/, with output matching the records/ run. Run cargo test --locked.
criteria.evidence: without_a_worktree_every_reader_falls_back_to_the_in_tree_records shows that load_current, RecordSet::load_current and read_records(records_root) equal the old results. status_reads_the_worktree_and_matches_the_in_tree_run runs the built `athena status <job> --json` binary and shows the output matches between records at HEAD and records in the worktree. No forecast is run anywhere, and the fallback is not shown for each moved reader, only for the shared loaders and status.

criteria.criterion: The worktree path is defined once, in crates/athena-data/src/paths.rs beside repo_state_dir. No non-test reader joins records/ itself outside paths.rs and the fallback.
criteria.evidence: paths.rs defines records_worktree, records_dir and records_root right after repo_state_dir. A grep of crates/*/src for "records" joins finds only paths.rs:65. RecordSet::load_dir and the introspect and walltime walks use records_dir. The scan passes on the real tree.

criteria.criterion: An xtask scan test named records_reader_scan fails on planted reads (join("records"), read_records(<repo dir>), Records::load(git, head), and crate::store::Records::load(git, head)). It passes on the real tree with an allow-list in which every entry has a reason. The scan was first run against the real tree to produce the call-site inventory. Run cargo test -p xtask --locked records_reader_scan and confirm a nonzero number of tests ran.
criteria.evidence: 3 passed (nonzero). The planted test flags each of the four required patterns plus RecordSet::load(. The real-tree test checks that every allow-list entry has a non-empty reason and exists. The inventory is summarised in D134 provenance only as about 25 call sites, not listed.

criteria.criterion: xtask/src/site.rs is untouched, and the site output is identical with records/ present and absent. Run cargo run -p xtask -- site both ways and compare the outputs.
criteria.evidence: site.rs has no diff. The planned alternative, a test in xtask/src/main.rs, builds the site on a temp root with and without records/ and asserts index.html is identical; it passes. I did not run `cargo run -p xtask -- site` both ways myself, because that would mean creating records/ in the snapshot, which my role forbids.

criteria.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and the full cargo test --locked pass, with existing tests unchanged.
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded checks: fmt passed, clippy passed, and cargo test --locked passed with 1347 tests. Reading the diff shows only production call sites changed and new test functions added. No existing test was edited.

criteria.criterion: docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md record the reader move, the fallback, the allow-list, and that the site generator is out of scope, citing D111.
criteria.evidence: The new D134 entry in docs/decisions.md and the new CHANGELOG Unreleased entry both cite D111 and name the reader move, the fallback, the allow-list with reasons and records_reader_scan, and that site.rs is unchanged.

findings.summary: Criterion 1's named readers (forecasting, scoring, retry carry, auditor, audit, introspect, proposals, backtest) have no worktree-versus-in-tree test
findings.evidence: The new file tests only the shared loaders, read_records, status/trace/mistakes and land_pr; walltime is tested in xtask. The callers in auditor.rs:300, reading.rs:701 (retry), manage.rs:194 and run.rs:2392 (scoring), introspect.rs:1246/1283/1314, proposals.rs:556 and backtest.rs:510 are never exercised with a worktree.

findings.summary: Criterion 4's forecast run on a scratch checkout is missing
findings.evidence: Only `athena status` is run as a binary. No test or command produces a forecast with records/ absent from the working tree.

findings.summary: backtest and xtask walltime derive the git common dir as `<root>/.git`, so in a linked worktree they miss the records worktree and silently fall back
findings.evidence: repo_state_dir keys on the canonical common git dir. In a linked worktree `.git` is a file, so the key differs from git.common_dir() and records_root returns the checkout. After the cutover that checkout has no records/. Other readers use git.common_dir().

findings.summary: Scoring closures that receive a given head now ignore it when a worktree exists
findings.evidence: Inside commit_records_in and score_on, `head` is passed in, but load_current reads the worktree regardless of it. This is probably intended after the cutover, but it is not tested or explained in D134.

findings.summary: Whole files are allow-listed, so a future live reader added to store.rs, reconcile.rs, history.rs or attribution.rs would escape the scan
findings.evidence: records_reader_findings skips any path that matches an allow-list entry. The entries are not tied to individual call sites.

findings.summary: Tests write records-worktree under the real state root
findings.evidence: records_worktree uses state_root() (ATHENA_STATE_DIR or ~/.local/state/athena) rather than a temp directory. The directories are removed on drop, but a crashed test leaves them behind on the host.

summary: I ran the new tests in the snapshot: the scan tests (3 passed), the six worktree reader integration tests, the walltime worktree test and the site present/absent test all pass. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and full test runs passed. The core move works: paths.rs defines the worktree path once, beside repo_state_dir. Records::load_current and RecordSet::load_current read the worktree and fall back to the given ref when it is absent, and every live reader that loaded from HEAD now uses them, including land_pr at gh.rs:2513 and the introspect walks. The scan flags all the planted patterns, site.rs is untouched, and D134 and the CHANGELOG cover all four points. The verdict is still fail, because two criteria are not shown. Criterion 1 names forecasting, scoring, retry carry, the auditor and audit, but none of them (nor introspect's callers, proposals or backtest) is tested against a worktree that differs from records/. Criterion 4 asks for a forecast to succeed on a scratch checkout, and no forecast is run. Minor issues: backtest and walltime compute the common git dir as `<root>/.git`, so they miss the worktree when run from a linked worktree. The scoring closures now ignore the head passed to them. The allow-list exempts whole files. The tests write to the real state root.
